name: SARC
description: We introduce the Self-Annotated Reddit Corpus (SARC), a large corpus for sarcasm research and for training and evaluating systems for sarcasm detection. The corpus has 1.3 million sarcastic statements -- 10 times more than any previous dataset -- and many times more instances of non-sarcastic statements, allowing for learning in both balanced and unbalanced label regimes. Each statement is furthermore self-annotated -- sarcasm is labeled by the author, not an independent annotator -- and provided with user, topic, and conversation context. We evaluate the corpus for accuracy, construct benchmarks for sarcasm detection, and evaluate baseline methods.
reputation: A classic and widely cited sarcasm detection corpus that has been used extensively in sentiment and pragmatics research.
notes: Self-annotated labels may introduce noise; the dataset is large but sarcasm detection remains context-dependent and sensitive to domain shift.
